cases.title: Correct branch and supplier in each session

rows.label: Expected
rows.value: Session A lists supplier `NDCGal`. Session B lists supplier `Galileo`. After reload, each session still shows its own branch, and selecting a branch in one session does not change the other.

cases.title: Parity — Multi-City, different Cabin per leg

rows.label: Expected
rows.value: Both branches return the same combinations and fare options. On both branches, leg 1 segments are Economy and leg 2 segments are Business, with the same RBD and baggage allowance per segment.

cases.title: Cabin Class filter returns only the selected cabin

rows.label: Expected
rows.value: For each Cabin Class searched, on each branch, the result set is not empty and every segment of every fare option is in the selected cabin.

rows.label: Expected
rows.value: For each RBD, on each branch, the result set is not empty and every segment of every fare option has the selected RBD in Economy. Both branches return the same flights for the same RBD.

rows.label: Expected
rows.value: For each RBD, on each branch, the result set is not empty and every segment of every fare option has the selected RBD in Business. Both branches return the same flights for the same RBD.

rows.label: Expected
rows.value: For each RBD, on each branch, the result set is not empty and every segment of every fare option has the selected RBD in First Class. Both branches return the same flights for the same RBD.

rows.label: Expected
rows.value: On each branch, the result set is not empty and every segment of every fare option has RBD `J` in Premium Economy. Both branches return the same flights.

cases.title: RBD filter — several RBDs selected together (Q + K)

rows.label: Expected
rows.value: On each branch, the result set is not empty and every segment of every fare option has RBD `Q` or `K`. Both branches return the same flights.

cases.title: RBD filter — on one Multi-City leg only

rows.label: Expected
rows.value: On each branch, the result set is not empty, every leg 1 segment has RBD `Q`, and leg 2 is not limited to `Q`. Both branches return the same combinations.

cases.title: Parity — Cabin Class and RBD that do not match

rows.label: Expected
rows.value: Both branches give the same outcome: the same message, or the same fare options with the same Cabin Class and RBD.

items: Rev 2: test data validated live on 2026-10-11 (both branches, search only); DXB routes replaced by CAI routes — see CoverageReport.md §13.
RBD coverage widened: Economy Q/K/Y, Business J/C, First F/A, Premium J, Q+K together, and per-leg RBD in Multi-City.
Multi-City parity added (supported on both branches, with per-leg Cabin and RBD).
Retired: TC-GSRCH-008 and 009 (merged into every parity case), TC-GSRCH-014 (out of focus).
RBD, Cabin and baggage compared per fare option × passenger type × segment. Fare Basis is not returned on either branch.
Parity and filter validation are separate (CMP-05); every result compared or Inconclusive (CMP-06).
